title: Commonsense-Grounded Path Planning from Abstract Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2609.22813v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present \emph{commonsense ranked search} (CoRS), a novel path planner that turns an abstract instruction into a route that follows commonsense. While existing methods respect the considerations written down in advance, a robot working among people must follow those left unstated too, as with a wet floor that a worker avoids without being told. CoRS leverages large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) as commonsense knowledge to reason about these latent considerations in its planning. Given an abstract instruction (\emph{e.g.}, ``move carefully'') and visual observations of each region in the environment, CoRS derives a consideration for each region, as in ``this wet floor is slippery and worth a detour.'' It then compares the considerations between regions to see which of the two the robot should avoid more, as in ``the crowd is worse than the wet floor.'' These judgments sort the regions into a commonsense rank

translated_title: 基于常识的抽象指令路径规划
translated_abstract: 我们提出了常识排序搜索，这是一种新颖的路径规划器，能够将抽象指令转化为遵循常识的路线。现有方法只能尊重事先明确写下的考虑因素，但在人群中工作的机器人还必须遵守那些未被言明的因素，例如工人在无人告知的情况下也会避开湿滑的地面。CoRS 利用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）作为常识知识，在规划过程中推理这些潜在的考虑因素。给定一个抽象指令（例如“小心移动”）以及环境中每个区域的视觉观察，CoRS 为每个区域推导出一个考虑因素，例如“这片湿地面很滑，值得绕行”。随后，它比较各区域之间的考虑因素，判断机器人应该更多地避开哪一个，例如“人群比湿地面更糟糕”。这些判断将各区域排序为一个常识排序。
tldr: 提出了CoRS路径规划器，利用大语言模型和视觉语言模型作为常识知识，将抽象指令转化为能够遵循人类未言明常识（如避开湿滑地面）的路线。
en_tdlr: CoRS is a novel path planner that leverages LLMs and VLMs as commonsense knowledge to convert abstract instructions into routes that respect unstated human considerations, such as avoiding wet floors.
